working_title: Containers Are Containers — Safe Storage by Function

owner_input.idea: Opportunity Intelligence spin-off: teach safe water storage by function so learners can distinguish drinking-water storage, livestock storage and agricultural/non-potable uses without treating every container as equivalent.
owner_input.owner_notes: Spawn strong Water opportunities into normal Academy research when sufficiently defined and not blocked by an owner gate.
owner_input.requested_angle: Function before form; use what you have only after suitability is checked; safe storage prevents recontamination; teach why intended use changes the standard.

websites_reviewed: https://academy.rebelranchministries.org (live fetch attempted; crawler unavailable; current GitHub hub source reviewed)
context_review.learning_area_reason: Storage is a core water-system function connecting household safety, resilience, agriculture and practical resource management.

conflicts_found: Storage guidance differs by intended use. Potable household storage requires stronger contamination controls than many livestock or irrigation uses; the project therefore rejects a one-standard-fits-all container rule.
unresolved_questions: species-specific livestock thresholds beyond general clean/fresh-water guidance
crop-specific agricultural-water requirements for particular commodities and postharvest uses
material-specific long-term migration performance for every reused container type
